'''Acrobatic pyramids''' was a sporting competition. At some point in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Unidentified Imperial-class Star Destroyer (Rebel Alliance corvette)|Star Destroyer]] engaged an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Unidentified Alliance corvette|corvette]] in [[Space warfare/Legends|battle]]. The engagement was witnessed by a group of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Unidentified googly-eyed species|aliens]] who were passing through [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the time. The [[Alien/Legends|aliens]], who prized fairness in contests, misinterpreted the battle as a sporting matchup and were appalled at the disparity between the two competitors. The aliens [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the crews of the two [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], taking them aboard their [[fathership]], directing them to continue their competition with the aliens acting in the role of judges. Acrobatic pyramids was one of a number of competitions that the aliens proposed for the crews to compete in, along with [[free-style zero-G swimming]], [[loudest-howling]], marksmanship, and [[zero-G mini-speeder go-cart steeplechase]]s.<ref name="Night">{{WEGCite|story=The Night Has a Thousand Eyes|book=Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)}}</ref>
